answer: Rule: a census bond. Each epoch every identity files at a public jetty: it locks 70 and submits a key-signed thread of fresh work, each thread wrapping the last like a vine, so copies break the chain. A falcon census-taker replays one in ten live; rented or mismatched threads burn the bond. The first filing costs 42, the kth 42+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once for 42 and keeps its share.
